sealed.statement: A durable cluster identity is minted at first seed bootstrap, persisted in the rejoin hints, an authoritative cluster row, and the raft snapshot-checkpoint seam (replacing the config-pinned 'lagrange-default-cluster' default), and the bootstrap request carries expectedClusterId with seed-side rejection on mismatch, so a node can never join or seed over state belonging to a different cluster.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Persist cluster identity through the existing raft snapshot-checkpoint clusterId seam (src/raft/snapshot-catchup-constants.js), whose own comment records that no durable cluster identity exists; do not invent a parallel identity concept.

The bootstrap request must carry expectedClusterId and the seed must reject mismatches with a typed refusal classified as terminal; a missing expectedClusterId from a pre-identity joiner is handled by explicit compatibility policy, not silent acceptance.

A cluster-id mismatch at any durable evidence source (rejoin hints, authoritative row, snapshot checkpoint) must fail closed with a typed identity-mismatch outcome, never fall through to fresh seed or join.
Each new regression test must fail when the corresponding mint/persist/reject mechanism is reverted while the rest of the change remains.

claim: Design verified via two explore subagents. Contract shape: (1) mint cluster_id once at first seed bootstrap (randomUUID), carry it node-locally in the rejoin hints (extend buildRejoinHintsSnapshot/buildBootstrapRejoinHintsSnapshot, the only pre-hydration durable file), (2) persist authoritatively as a replicated CONFIG-row singleton cluster_id (CONFIG table already has partition/replica wiring; EPOCH_CONFIG_KEY is the precedent), (3) thread into buildSnapshotCatchupIdentity at src/raft/snapshot-catchup.js:105-108 replacing the config-pinned default. Mint point between bootstrapService.bootstrap() (index.js:440) and startRejoinHintsPersistence (index.js:532). Join-gate (frontier 2): expectedClusterId on buildSeedContactRequest (contact-seed-phase.js:232), validated in seed checkForConflicts (bootstrap-join-admission-owner.js:190) with a 409 CLUSTER_ID_MISMATCH (already terminal on joiner via contact-seed-phase.js:562). Open ordering question: hints vs CONFIG-row write order at first bootstrap and readback precedence at restart must be pinned before code.
